comment: Source read at commit 21bfcbf, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0. The knob values are copied into the store for the current step on every sample (setValues at 16Squared.cpp:112) and copied back out of it whenever the step changes, which is what makes one row of knobs serve all sixteen steps. The buttons are read through the same Schmitt trigger shape as the jacks, against the parameter value rather than a voltage.
